speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you have been experiencing unusual behavior and beliefs about telepathic communication with animals; please tell me, how long have you noticed these symptoms and have they been getting worse?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old male. The patient presents with a chief complaint of 'failing health.' He reports an inability to communicate telepathically with animals, which he believes he could previously do, affected by the current weather conditions. He has started taking assorted Peruvian herbs without any improvement. He denies taking any medications. The symptoms have been ongoing for the past eight months.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Delusional disorder, somatic type.

I'm sorry to hear about your health struggles. To confirm if this belief system is affecting your daily life and safety, can you describe a specific incident where you felt unable to communicate with an animal due to the weather?
